The '''1990–91 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], two points ahead of [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. Rangers had seemed on course for a comfortable victory in the championship, but a loss of form around the time of manager [[Graeme Souness]] leaving the club allowed a surging Aberdeen to take the lead in the championship after 35 games.<ref name = "decider"/> The two clubs played a league-deciding match against one another in the final game of the season at [[Ibrox Stadium|Ibrox]] (only the second time the championship had been settled on the last day between the challengers, after [[1964–65 Scottish Division One|1965]] – it would occur again in [[2025–26 Scottish Premiership|2026]]).<ref name = "decider">{{cite web |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/scot_prem/7410206.stm |title=SPL title battle hangs in balance |first=David |last=McDaid |work=BBC Sport |publisher=BBC |date=20 May 2008 |access-date=1 March 2013}}</ref><ref>[https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/4-rare-final-day-winner-095508797.html The 4 rare final-day winner-takes-all Scottish premiership title deciders], Laura Pollock, ''The National'' via ''Yahoo! Sport'', 15 May 2026</ref><ref>[https://www.scotsman.com/sport/football/scottish-premiership/latest-premiership-news/scottish-football-braces-itself-for-an-almighty-climax-with-celtic-v-hearts-8549260 Scottish football braces itself for an almighty climax with Celtic v Hearts], Mark Atkinson, ''The Scotsman'', 15 May 2026</ref> With Aberdeen only requiring a draw, [[Mark Hateley]] scored both goals in a 2–0 victory for Rangers, giving them their third successive league championship and 41st overall.<ref name = "decider"/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/36263204 |title=Rangers and Aberdeen's epic duel for the 1991 Scottish title – 25 years ago|date=11 May 2016|access-date=1 December 2021|work=[[BBC Sport]]}}</ref><ref name=prem91>{{cite news|url=http://www.heraldscotland.com/sport/13030001.FLASHBACK__1991_______Mark_Walters_and_Scott_Booth_recall_their_part_in_Smith___s_maiden_final_day_triumph_walters_BOOTH/|title=Flashback: 1991, Mark Walters and Scott Booth recall their part in Smith's maiden final-day triumph|date=14 May 2011|access-date=1 December 2021|newspaper=[[The Herald (Scotland)|The Herald]]}}</ref> Due to a league expansion from 10 to 12 teams, no clubs were relegated.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/premier-division/1991-1992/table |title=Scottish Premier Division 1991-1992 Table |publisher=statto.com |access-date=2012-03-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110907001145/http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/premier-division/1991-1992/table |archive-date=2011-09-07 |url-status=live }}</ref>
